questionSet_explained: Prep Review · Personal Lines · Pearson Vue · 5 questions
Question 1 of 5 · Prep Review: Types of Casualty Insurance Policies - Personal Lines - Pearson Vue

Ted is covered by an HO-3 policy and is insured to value. The covered dwelling has a replacement value of $200,000 and Ted carries $160,000 of coverage. If a fire causes a total loss, how much will the policy pay?

Ted is insured to value: $160,000 is 80% of the $200,000 replacement value, so losses settle at replacement cost, but never above the Coverage A limit. On a total loss the policy pays its limit, $160,000.
